name: plaiiin-tradingsuite
description: Design, backtest, and improve trading strategies from Claude — drives your local Plaiiin Forge app.
long_description: Plaiiin TradingSuite connects Claude to your locally running Plaiiin Forge app over its unix socket, exposing tools to list/create/update/validate strategies, run backtests, read AI-friendly summaries and trades, manage phases/levels/hoops, evaluate DSL conditions, and fetch candles/indicators. Ask Claude to analyze why a strategy loses and improve it end-to-end. Requires the Plaiiin app to be installed and running.

run_dir.title: Plaiiin run directory
run_dir.description: Folder where the running Plaiiin app exposes forge.sock (the shared App-Group run dir). Leave the default unless you run a custom dev setup.
